guards.name: frame parity
guards.statistic: max abs diff over an 11 x 11 lattice, m

guards.name: ring self-consistency
guards.statistic: max abs diff p vs to_local(lonlat), m
guards.rule: north-up < 0.05 m and the mirrored copy is far off

guards.name: buildings vs water
guards.evidence: Overture water polygons (OSM canals; independent of BAG)
guards.statistic: share of footprint area overlapping water

guards.name: landmarks
guards.statistic: distance to the nearest footprint of plausible area, m
guards.rule: north-up <= 60 m for EACH; mirrored >= 100 m for each and a median >= 200 m

guards.name: heights vs AHN nDSM
guards.evidence: AHN4 dsm_05m - dtm_05m (ground under buildings filled from the nearest valid DTM), p70 inside each footprint
guards.statistic: Spearman rho between 3D BAG h and nDSM p70

detail.note: AHN4 (2020-22) vs AHN5-dominated 3D BAG heights: a one-to-three-year gap, so some disagreement is real change

guards.name: terrain registration
guards.evidence: the AHN DTM nodata mask (no ground points under buildings or water)
guards.statistic: Jaccard of the DTM nodata mask vs rasterised footprints + water at 2 m, inside the square

guards.name: surface raster
guards.evidence: Overture land_use park polygons (Vondelpark and others)
guards.statistic: mean vegetation fraction inside parks minus outside, from the exported PNG (row 0 = north)

guards.name: export orientation
guards.rule: equal; the unflipped compare must differ

waterLevel.reference: Amsterdam canals are held near NAP -0.40 m in summer (zomerpeil); that figure is NOT verified here, so this block records what the data say and gates nothing
